paragraphs: Abba or Ada bar Avimi: Eruvin 9b. Rav Tachlifa bar Avimi: Pesachim 107a.[^1]

notes.text: The whole Davidson Eruvin 9b paragraph writes Rav Ada bar Avimi, while Pesachim 107a writes Rav Tachlifa bar Avimi. Hyman’s Abba-or-Ada alternative and separate pointers remain as supplied. No common father, relationship to the separately published Avimi entry, or authority identity is admitted.
